Legal

Privacy Policy · Terms of Service

About StoryWriter

Built by Mason Carter for indie authors who want a private offline desk. No pricing, no tiers, no accounts.

Projects stay in this browser unless you use Save disk / Open disk. Export DOCX, design print layouts, or export EPUB & PDF from Designs.

Browser storage (offline)

Checking…

Large covers and design snapshots use the most space. Prefer Save disk for backups. This app has no server — data never leaves your device unless you export or save a file.

Sync & backup

Google Drive sync

Optional cloud backup for this browser. Files are stored in your Drive as StoryWriter JSON (only files this app creates). Local IndexedDB remains the working copy. Long-lived reconnect uses a small Cloudflare helper on this domain (refresh tokens are not stored in the browser). By connecting, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
